bus_address.description: DBus system bus address; use 'auto' to auto-detect or specify a path (e.g., /run/dbus/system_bus_socket)

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the service

max_connection_attempts.description: Maximum number of connection attempts to a remote server before marking it unavailable

connection_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each individual remote server connection attempt

scan_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between scans to discover new remote logon servers

enable_logging.description: Enable logging of connection successes/failures and discovery events

cache_dir.description: Directory where discovered server metadata is cached

cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached server entries

trusted_servers.description: List of trusted remote server hostnames or IPs (if empty, all discovered servers are considered untrusted and subject to filtering)

server_groups.description: Custom server groups to prioritize or isolate; each group defines hosts, weight, and optional filter

weight.description: Priority weight (higher = more likely to be chosen)

hosts.description: List of hosts in this group

tls.description: Use TLS for this host (overrides global setting if present)

filter.description: Filter applied to discovered servers in this group (e.g., 'all', 'only_trusted')

credentials_file.description: Path to file containing authentication credentials (e.g., username/password); leave empty to disable auth

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS for outbound connections to remote servers (applies globally unless overridden in server_groups)

ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate bundle (required only if enable_tls is true)

client_cert_path.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS (optional)

client_key_path.description: Path to client private key (required only if mutual TLS is enabled)
